title: On Operating the pump by hand throughout
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：operate　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 operate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the warden ① operated the pump by hand throughout in silence, and every resident in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the warden ② operates the pump by hand throughout twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ operate the pump by hand throughout at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ operated the pump by hand throughout before — a line in the register for June 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Operating the pump by hand throughout in silence, the warden said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ operate on the boy before midnight twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Operate on the boy before midnight at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new resident from the next centre ⑧ operates on the boy before midnight in silence every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ operated the pump by hand throughout again when nobody else would.

⑩ To operate the pump by hand throughout, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the centre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the centre forgets, somebody operates the pump by hand throughout twice over again and somebody must operate the pump by hand throughout in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 操作（一般过去式 operated the pump by hand throughout：1990 年管理员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 操作（一般现在 operates the pump by hand throughout：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 操作（不定式 to operate the pump by hand throughout：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 操作（过去完成时 had operated the pump by hand throughout：1984 年六月的登记册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 操作（动名词 operating the pump by hand throughout 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 动手术（operate on the boy before midnight：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去动手术午夜前给孩子动了手术）
G. v. 动手术（operate on the boy before midnight：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 操作（后段两处：新来的居民照例 operates on the boy before midnight，而母亲又一次 operated the pump by hand throughout）

answers.why: operate 意为“操作”，1990 年管理员一言不发地操作一直用手操作那台水泵，那是社区中心里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 operated。
operate 意为“操作”，自那以后管理员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 operates。
operate 意为“操作”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯操作一直用手操作那台水泵”，此处为不定式 to operate the pump by hand throughout。
operate 意为“操作”，登记册里 六月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人操作过，故用过去完成时 had operated。
operate 意为“操作”，管理员说“操作一直用手操作那台水泵这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 operating the pump by hand throughout 作主语。
operate 意为“动手术”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去动手术午夜前给孩子动了手术”，should ever 之后用原形 operate on the boy before midnight。
operate 意为“动手术”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻动手术午夜前给孩子动了手术（operate on the boy before midnight at once），以后再也不要提起。
operate 意为“操作”，新来的居民每个月份都照例动手术午夜前给孩子动了手术，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 operates。
operate 意为“操作”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地操作一直用手操作那台水泵，用一般过去式 operated 叙述。
operate 意为“操作”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要操作一直用手操作那台水泵，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和社区中心记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1990 the warden operated the pump by hand throughout in silence, and nobody in the centre forgot it.
Even now the warden operates the pump by hand throughout twice over whenever the centre asks.
Operating the pump by hand throughout in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever operate on the boy before midnight twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
